case_level_notes: Direct-to-furnisher dispute that fails qualifying-dispute prerequisites; bank responded by requesting missing information.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Marking satisfied/NA only because no CRA-transmission branch is engaged here; no facts indicate a CRA route.

material_facts.fact: Dispute arrived at bank's published dispute address, not via a CRA

determinations.rationale: No CRA path is involved; the dispute came directly to the bank at its published dispute address. The CRA-to-furnisher notice branch is not applicable.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Item-treatment duty arises only when defect is found; here none was found, so the duty branch is outside scope.
determinations.decisive_branch: not-applicable branch (no defect found requiring treatment)

material_facts.fact: Bank marked packet insufficient; no investigation finding of inaccuracy

determinations.rationale: No defect was identified because the packet was insufficient; no inaccurate/incomplete/unverifiable finding triggers item treatment duties. The branch is not engaged.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Indirect duties trigger only on CRA notice; none occurred.

material_facts.fact: Dispute was direct to bank, not via a CRA

determinations.rationale: There is no CRA-transmitted dispute, so indirect furnisher duties under 1681s-2(b) are not engaged.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: Does not assert investigation occurred; treats the duty as not engaged because the packet failed qualifying-dispute prerequisites, which the policy permits.
determinations.decisive_branch: not-applicable branch (non-qualifying direct dispute; bank requested missing info)

material_facts.fact: Message did not identify account or specific disputed field
Bank marked insufficient and requested missing details

determinations.rationale: The direct dispute did not identify the account, the specific disputed information, or include supporting documents. Under the policy and profile, this is an insufficient packet; the bank reasonably treated it as such and requested missing details. The qualifying-dispute prerequisites for an investigation duty are not met, so the duty is satisfied/not applicable on these facts. Frivolous-notice timing is not asserted as violated in the narrative.

determinations.anti_overclaim_check: No routing cue listed in profile triggers appears in the narrative.
determinations.rationale: No identity theft, mixed-file, court order, missing source documents in a substantive investigation, conflicting dates, or manual-review policy trigger appears. The packet was simply insufficient and handled by an information request.
